subject: [COMPANY]'s AI Pipeline
text:
[NAME], 

There's a pattern we keep seeing with ML teams at your stage: engineers burning sprint cycles on a pipeline stage that isn't the actual constraint. 

Labeling is usually the first thing to get attention; it's measurable, the team can point to output, and it's easy to staff up. But when we map the pipeline, the real throughput bottleneck is in curation or validation far more often than anyone expects. Model performance doesn't move. Nobody can explain why. 

We built a diagnostic that identifies which stage it actually is for your setup; maps across curation, labeling, QA, and validation, and generates a fix-priority report. 

If that's useful, I'll send it over.

text:

intelligence - building reliable ML on messy, real-world audio is one of

shifts to evaluating whether the new version actually sounds better on
tough audio. Comparing outputs side by side at scale is a real pain.

audio review cycles by and catch regressions before they ship.
